lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll separate two sounds that turn one word into its opposite. They’re... …NOW and NO! Down and don’t are not the same word: down

Both are diphthongs: two vowels glued together, moving in one breath. Portuguese pulls both to the nearest sound we have, and they collapse into one.
